name: WorkFar Syntro
summary: A wheeled humanoid made in the USA with two arms, 12-DOF hands and a three-wheel omni base, run by teleoperation (VR, gloves) or onboard AI for logistics and manufacturing work. The maker states a 20 kg payload and 6-10 h runtime.

germany.statusNote: Sold only through the maker's US online store, with a stated lead time of about 6 months for the base robot. No German or EU distributor was found.

priceOther.market: US maker store, package 1 (Syntro Base humanoid robot only, with SDK); marked as a sale price against a regular price of USD 59,990. Packages with telepresence and AI add-ons go up to USD 59,999.99.

germany.leadTime: ETA 6 months for the Base robot, 12 months for the Telepresence/Intelligent packages (maker store)

specs.label: Payload
specs.conditions: maker figure; not split into arm payload or carried load

specs.label: Degrees of freedom
specs.conditions: Head 2, arms 4 x2, wrists 3 x2, hands 12 x2, waist 2, wheels 3
specs.quote: Degrees of Freedom: Head: 2 / Arms: 4 (x2) / Wrist: 3 (x2) / Hands: 12 (x2) / Waist: 2 / Wheels: 3

specs.label: Runtime
specs.quote: Power: Swappable Batteries 1.2 kWh / Run Time: 6-10 Hours / Charge Time: 6-10 Hours

specs.label: Drive
specs.quote: Motion: 3 All-directional Omni Wheels / Anthropomorphic Arms / Dexterous Hands

specs.label: Sensors
specs.quote: Sensors/Input: 2D LiDAR / Camera(s) / Computer Vision / Microphone(s)

specs.label: Compute and software
specs.value: Intel Core i5, Linux with ROS2
specs.quote: Software: Intel Multi Core I5 / Custom Linux running ROS2

specs.label: Warranty
specs.quote: Warranty: 30 day warranty for Syntro “Base” and “Telepresence”; 6 month warranty for Syntro “Intelligent”.

capabilities.sdk: SDK included; ROS2 on custom Linux (maker)
notes: The 20 kg payload is not split into arm payload or carried load, so it is not used as a payload figure here.
